title: Skyscraper functor for modules on a ringed space
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space (a topological space with a sheaf of commutative rings $\mathcal O_X$ on its site of opens), and $x\in X$, with stalk ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. For an $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-module $M$, define $i_{x,*}M$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] by $(i_{x,*}M)(U)=M$ if $x\in U$, and $0$ otherwise. Sections are equivalently functions from the proposition $x\in U$ to $M$; restrictions are precomposition with the inclusion of membership proofs. A scalar $a\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ acts by its germ at $x$ whenever $x\in U$. Module morphisms act pointwise on sections. This defines an additive functor, extended termwise to cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules].
